# Policy keys the last released binary accepts: codeflow v3.1.1.
# One dotted key path per line. Lines starting with # are comments.
# TSK-280 reads this list; see "Where a new key goes" in docs/policy-reference.md.
#
# Refresh it after a release publishes, in the change that first needs the
# new list. A stale list only keeps a newer key out of the template, which is
# the safe side. Regenerate it from the release tag (replace v3.1.1):
#   { git show v3.1.1:crates/codeflow-core/src/hooks/policy_schema.rs \
#       | grep -o 'path: "[^"]*"' | sed 's/path: "\(.*\)"/\1/'
#     git show v3.1.1:crates/codeflow-core/src/hooks/policy_schema.rs \
#       | sed -n '/pub const DEPRECATED_KEYS/,/^];/p' \
#       | grep -o '^        "[a-z_.]*",$' | tr -d ' ",'
#   } | sort -u
# The deprecated keys are listed too: the released binary accepts them.
